title: Degree and leading coefficient of odd predivision polynomials
statement: Let F be a characteristic-zero field with decidable equality, W a Weierstrass equation over F, and n an odd natural number with 3 ≤ n. Then (W.preΨ' n).natDegree = (n² − 1)/2 and (W.preΨ' n).leadingCoeff = n, with n interpreted in F in the second equality. No discriminant hypothesis is required.
lean_statement: ∀ (F : Type) [Field F] [CharZero F] [DecidableEq F] (W : WeierstrassCurve F) (n : ℕ), 3 ≤ n → Odd n → (W.preΨ' n).natDegree = (n ^ 2 - 1) / 2 ∧ (W.preΨ' n).leadingCoeff = (n : F)
